paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin, chapter 3, halakha 7: he spoke in the name of R' Yose bar R' Hanina.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman's reporting direction is preserved: Chiyya speaks in the name of R' Yose bar R' Hanina. The bar in בר' is a patronymic marker; it does not independently establish an authority or genealogy binding. Heading ר' חייא and both abbreviated body titles remain R' because no exact named-edition primary passage is supplied here to justify full Rabbi expansions. The source gives Gittin chapter3, halakhah7. The chapter/halakhah format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but no exact passage or printed page was freshly checked; the body retains the supplied locator. The original note and older full Rabbi English remain archived, without printing-history proof or automatic note retirement. The prior model PASS_TEXTUAL is not automatic title or identity admission.
